consequence.statement: No operational consequence: the addition only extends the CRD schema, and per the field's description the status subresource is read-only, under active development, and updated only when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled.

assertion.statement: Between prometheus-operator 0.85.0 and 0.86.2, the v1 schema of prometheusrules.monitoring.coreos.com gains a read-only `status` field (with status.bindings[].group, .name, .namespace, .resource and status.bindings[].conditions[] entries), which per the CRD description is under active development and is updated only when the StatusForConfigurationResources feature gate is enabled.
